Definition: properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication, a libation, i.e. league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out)
BiblicalUsage: 1) a pouring, libation, molten metal, cast image, drink offering; 1a) libation (with covenant sacrifice); 1b) molten metal, molten image, molten gods; 2) web, covering, veil, woven stuff
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
